defaults.summary: Typesense full-text search, one instance and key per group.

runtime.start:
: "${TYPESENSE_API_KEY:?this instance started without the key of its group}"
mkdir -p "$STACK_DATA_DIR/data"
exec "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/typesense-server" --data-dir "$STACK_DATA_DIR/data" --api-address 127.0.0.1 --api-port "$STACK_PORT" --peering-address 127.0.0.1 --peering-port "${STACK_PORT_PEERING:?this Typesense entry needs a newer Stack}"
runtime.ready:
url="http://127.0.0.1:$STACK_PORT/health"
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsS -o /dev/null "$url"
else
  wget -q -O /dev/null "$url"
fi

notes.name: key
notes.text: The server starts with the group's key as its admin API key, read from its environment, and answers every route but /health only to a request carrying it as X-TYPESENSE-API-KEY; sites get it as TYPESENSE_API_KEY.

notes.name: listener
notes.text: It listens on 127.0.0.1 over HTTP only, on its port and on a second, peering port Stack allocates for its cluster protocol, and keeps its whole index in memory, writing it to the instance's data directory.

notes.name: peering
notes.text: Its peering port, for the cluster protocol, asks for no key: any account on this machine can reach it on 127.0.0.1 and use the built-in pages it serves, such as /flags, /status, /vars, /connections and /raft_stat, to read and change the server's runtime settings, as Typesense 30.2 does. The API key does not protect it, so keep this instance off machines other people sign in to.

notes.name: group_rename
notes.text: A group rename does not carry its data: the index starts empty under the new name, so index the records again, as php artisan scout:import does for Laravel, and the old data directory stays until stack prune --data removes it.

recipes.title: Laravel Scout with Typesense
recipes.yaml:
group: shop
runtimes:
  php: "8.4"
services:
  - {name: search, type: typesense}
sites:
  - {name: app, type: laravel}
recipes.gives: Gives the site SCOUT_DRIVER=typesense, TYPESENSE_HOST, TYPESENSE_PORT, TYPESENSE_PROTOCOL and TYPESENSE_API_KEY, the same prefixed SEARCH_, and APP_URL.

recipes.title: A search server for any client
recipes.gives: Gives TYPESENSE_HOST, TYPESENSE_PORT, TYPESENSE_PROTOCOL=http and TYPESENSE_API_KEY, the key every request needs, and the same prefixed SEARCH_.
